risk_note: F1-10ka (orchestrator D10-1308; planning/05 F1-10k, the D1 page of the 2026-11-12 Agent change record). Admin menu agent-traces (AI 助手记录) gets two tabs on contract CT-24zzi (#3239), whose four operations are still x-implementation: planned and declared with usePlanned (the planned placeholder shows until the backend lands; rule tests mount without the planned list and a fake server). Sessions tab: adminListAgentSessions with filters user_id / session_id / badcase / reported / from-to and paging; rows carry no message text or phone. Trace drawer: adminGetAgentSession requested only from the click that opens it, once per opening (the server audits every read as agent_trace_view), stale answers dropped; text shown as stored (masked), null text as a placeholder; input and output tokens labelled separately, cost only as integer milli-fen. Reports tab: adminListAgentReports with status / overdue / from-to; the 48-hour state comes only from the row's deadline_at and overdue (BR-ID-15, the same rule as the workbench card agent_report_overdue), never from the local clock; overdue rows are flagged. Handling (agent.report): note trimmed and counted in code points 1-500 via text-length.ts, body note + expected_row_version, 20902 refreshes with a conflict notice. The workbench route /agent/reports?overdue=true opens the reports tab with the overdue filter under the agent-traces menu. A standing notice lists what is not wired yet (tool switch status, report reason enum, manual badcase), which also keeps the frozen admin-dashboard todo test green. Rule tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh); tsc -b test 0 errors before commit; Codex spec-test r1 pass (one S2 out-of-scope: input / output tokens could be swapped, handled in the implementation); red on couli-ci (25 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5: couli-ci fast run 2 and browser run 1 green, run.ts static 10/10. The review tool classifies the task as RV2: Codex money review r1 pass, no findings. Written by hand.
